name: scrapecreators
description: Fixed 11-call, read-only public social-media research bundle for one coherent target: Twitter/X profile, recent posts, and one supplied tweet; LinkedIn person, post, and company pages; Instagram profile and recent posts; and TikTok profile, hashtag results, and a regional trending feed. Twitter calls use SELAT-native x402; the remaining calls use synchronous Scrape Creators endpoints over MPP. Every call is paid independently through the SELAT Router.

twitterHandle.description: Public Twitter/X handle without @ for the same target represented by the other supplied identifiers.

tweetId.description: Numeric ID of one public tweet from or directly relevant to the target; not a tweet URL.

linkedinProfileUrl.description: Full public LinkedIn person-profile URL for the target.

linkedinPostUrl.description: Full public LinkedIn post or article URL to retrieve.

linkedinCompanyUrl.description: Full public LinkedIn company-page URL for the target's company.

instagramHandle.description: Public Instagram handle without @ for the same target.

tiktokHandle.description: Public TikTok handle without @ for the same target.

tiktokHashtag.description: TikTok hashtag relevant to the research target, without #.

region.description: Two-letter region code for the TikTok hashtag proxy and trending feed, for example US.
